items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ahmad Jamal, Monk. There was just so much music, and a lot of it was in New York.

ctx.x: Ahmad Jamal, Monk. There was just so much music, and a lot of it was in New York. Any given night, you could go to the Village Gate, the Vanguard, the – yeah, the Village Gate. The Blue Note hadn’t come into being yet, but the Five Spot, the Jazz Gallery. Coffee shops that were popular then: there was Cafe Wha. I think it’s still here.
